when_to_use: cinematic noir/dark jazz, muted trumpet over dark piano, extreme rubato drag, ppp-pp dynamics, scene-form arc, 35-65 BPM
style: cinematic noir jazz / dark-jazz scene score

defaults.feel: ultra-dragged/rubato - only the brushed-snare swirl stays near the grid, everything else floats behind it

signature_moves: the detective's walk: Am(maj7) -> Am7 -> Am6 -> Fmaj7(#11) -> E7(b9,b13)
the rainy alleyway: Cm9 -> Fm9 -> Abmaj7(#11) -> G7alt
cluster friction voicing: semitone pairs placed mid-chord
cadence_options: a scene may decay into silence rather than resolve
avoid: plain major triads or bright major sevenths
dense fast harmonic rhythm - hold chords for at least two bars

hook_archetypes.name: mournful-3-note-call
hook_archetypes.rhythm: a short 3-note muted-trumpet phrase over 1-2 bars, then silence
hook_archetypes.contour: slow bend or glissando into b5 or b3 from below
hook_archetypes.first_appears: Scene 2, answered by one low piano chord

hook_archetypes.name: decaying-chord-signature
hook_archetypes.rhythm: one struck chord left to ring across an entire phrase
hook_archetypes.contour: minor-major seventh or cluster voicing with no restrike until decay

alleyway-intro.note_lengths: near silence - one bass pluck every two bars and one chord over four bars

shadow-theme.note_lengths: short mournful phrases and long sustained notes separated by silence

confession-interlude.note_lengths: sparse duet between sax and piano

resolution-outro.note_lengths: theme restates then thins to one bass pluck and decaying chord

drum_skeleton.low_energy: constant soft brushed-snare swirl only, no kick, occasional ride fade on beat 1
drum_skeleton.mid_energy: swirl continues, near-inaudible felt kick on 1 and the '&' of 3, ride fades on 1 and 3
drum_skeleton.high_energy: the ceiling is a full quiet trio, not a louder pattern; density increases by adding voices only

arrangement_defaults.layout_rules: Scene 1: bass and one decaying piano chord; Scene 2: brush swirl and muted-trumpet theme over line cliche; Scene 3: trumpet exits and sub-tone tenor duets with piano; Scene 4: drums and bass stop, leaving reverb and one delayed note; Scene 5: quiet ensemble restates theme and slows into one bass pluck plus decaying chord

anti_boredom_rules: every chord decays fully before the next, with about two bars minimum
cut roughly half the melody notes a first draft would include
one full scene drops drums and bass entirely
mournful three-note call returns varied by register or answering instrument
ambient texture, if used, remains far below the music and may be omitted

bass_behavior.rhythmic_relationship: floats behind the brushed reference and may disappear for an entire scene
bass_behavior.density: one note every one or two bars
bass_behavior.articulation: dark upright plucks with full decay

groove_intent.feel: near-rubato cinematic drag around a soft brush reference
groove_intent.kick: absent or nearly inaudible felt accents
groove_intent.snare: continuous quiet brush swirl rather than backbeat
groove_intent.ensemble_relationship: all pitched voices float behind the brush and use silence as structural material

distinguishing_traits: scene-based cinematic narrative rather than song or solo form
extreme ppp-pp space and two-bar chord decay
near-rubato placement with complete rhythm-section drop in the fog scene

blockers: engine belum punya profil groove 'noir-jazz-rubato' di GROOVE_LIBRARY
